an9.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an9.4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nandako upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
an9.4:1.3: athakho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno
an9.4:1.4: athakho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsetvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi.
an9.4:1.5: vivariṃsu kho te bhikkhū bhagavato dvāraṃ.
an9.4:2.1: athakho bhagavā upaṭṭhānasālaṃ pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi
an9.4:2.2: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ etadavoca
an9.4:2.3: dīgho kho tyāyaṃ nandaka dhammapariyāyo bhikkhūnaṃ paṭibhāsi
an9.4:2.4: api me piṭṭhi āgilāyati bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitassa kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamānassāti.
an9.4:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā nandako sārajjāyamānarūpo ottappamāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.4:3.2: na kho pana mayaṃ bhante jānāma bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitoti
an9.4:3.3: sace hi mayaṃ bhante jāneyyāma bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitoti ettakaṃpi no nappaṭibhāseyyāti.
an9.4:4.1: athakho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ sārajjāyamānarūpaṃ viditvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ etadavoca
an9.4:4.3: etaṃ kho nandaka tumhākaṃ paṭirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdeyyātha
an9.4:4.5: dhammī vā kathā ariyo vā tuṇhībhāvo
an9.4:4.6: saddho nandaka bhikkhu hoti no ca sīlavā
an9.4:4.9: kinnāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā cāti
an9.4:4.10: yato ca kho nandaka bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca evaṃ so tenaṅgena paripūro hoti
an9.4:5.1: saddho ca nandaka bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca no ca lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamādhissa
an9.4:5.4: kinnāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamādhissāti

an9.4:6.1: saddho ca nandaka bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamādhissa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya
an9.4:6.6: evameva kho nandaka bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamādhissa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya
an9.4:6.9: kinnāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamādhissa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāyāti

an9.4:7.3: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.

an9.4:9.1: pañcime āvuso ānisaṃsā kālena dhammassavane kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:9.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti

an9.4:13.2: yathā yathāvuso bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti tattha ye te bhikkhū sekkhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti te taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā viriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya
an9.4:13.3: ye pana tattha bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanā sammadaññāvimuttā te taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ yeva anuyuttā viharanti
an9.4:13.4: ayaṃ āvuso pañcamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammassavane kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:13.5: ime kho āvuso pañca ānisaṃsā kālena dhammassavane kālena dhammasākacchāyāti. 5
